abstract_sentences.text: Point supervision has become a scalable solution to address dense annotation for infrared small target detection, but its performance is limited by two coupled bottlenecks: unstable pseudo-label evolution in cluttered, low-contrast infrared imagery and severe sample-distribution imbalance.

evidence.anchor: two coupled bottlenecks: unstable pseudo-label evolution

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we present a more adaptive and stable framework to address these issues.

evidence.anchor: a more adaptive and stable framework

abstract_sentences.text: Leveraging the intrinsic consistency between thermal radiation patterns and heat diffusion, we propose a physics-induced annotation strategy that expands single-point labels into reliable pseudo-masks.
To further enhance supervision and alleviate sample imbalance, we develop a bi-level dual-update framework that jointly optimizes detector weights, sample weights, and diffusion parameters.

evidence.anchor: jointly optimizes detector weights, sample weights, and diffusion parameters

abstract_sentences.text: A meta-classifier dynamically predicts sample-wise loss weights, while a differentiable diffusion module refines pseudo-labels with detection feedback, enabling adaptive interaction between training and hyperparameter optimization.

evidence.anchor: meta-classifier dynamically predicts sample-wise loss weights

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate five-fold annotation acceleration, superior detection accuracy, and comparable performance with 30% of the training data, validating the efficiency and practicality of our approach.

evidence.anchor: five-fold annotation acceleration ... 30% of the training data

introduction_moves.move: context: 定义 ISTD、应用和目标稀疏性，说明小目标约占总像素 0.15%。

evidence.anchor: targets are often shapeless and textureless

introduction_moves.move: problem: 全监督方法需要密集标注和大规模数据；SIRST-v1/IRSTD-1k 只有 200/800 training pairs。
failure_of_prior_work: online/offline 单点伪标签更新分别暴露过度演化、不稳定和 false positives。
failure_of_prior_work: 静态 reweighting 和 curriculum 依赖固定权重、手工 schedule，无法适应训练动态。

evidence.anchor: lack adaptability to the evolving training dynamics

introduction_moves.move: missing_insight/core_idea/method_preview: 把目标视为热源，用 diffusion 生成伪标签，并用 bi-level optimization 同时调整 detector、sample weights、diffusion parameters。

evidence.anchor: natural consistency between radiation patterns and physical heat diffusion

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list: 列出 dual-update、meta-classifier/differentiable diffusion、physics-guided mask 与效率/效果/样本量验证。

evidence.anchor: The core contributions can be summarized as follows

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy/chronology: 从 local contrast、filtering、low-rank 等传统 model-driven 方法推进到深度学习与 foundation-model 方法，并指出超参数和数据规模限制。
taxonomy: 将 point-based supervision 放到 detection、localization、segmentation 视野，比较点/框标注和目标外观假设。

evidence.anchor: Point-based supervision has been proposed for diverse visual perception tasks

related_work_moves.move: nearest_neighbor_contrast/gap_creation: 对 LESPS、MCLC、PAL 比较稳定性、false positives、人工调参与训练动态适应性。

evidence.anchor: it lacks adaptability to the constantly evolving training dynamics

method_moves.move: setup_notation: 引入 detector `N`、参数 `ω`、图像 `x_i`、伪标签 `ŷ_i(θ)`、样本权重 `α` 和扩散参数 `θ`。

evidence.anchor: where N denotes the detector with parameters

method_moves.move: state_problem: 将伪标签不稳定与样本不平衡写成相互放大的两个瓶颈。
derive: 给出外层 validation loss 与内层加权 training loss 的 bi-level formulation（Eq. 1）。
define_component: 把单点 `p_i` 设为局部热源，以可学习各向异性 diffusion tensor `D_θ(a,b)` 控制空间传播（Eq. 2）。

evidence.anchor: an infrared target acts as a local heat source

method_moves.move: explain_mechanism/give_intuition: 解释均匀区加快传播、边缘/高梯度区减慢传播，以填补缺失并避免边界 smearing。
derive/instantiate_algorithm: 离散 PDE 为迭代式（Eq. 3），以 `K` 次迭代取得 quasi-steady field，并与包含点的 superpixel prior 聚合（Eq. 4）。

evidence.anchor: After K iterations, u(K) represents the quasi-steady thermal field

method_moves.move: connect_to_prediction: 说明归一化后的 `ŷ_i(θ)` 同时保存物理连续性和结构边界，作为 bi-level 的可微监督信号。

evidence.anchor: preserves both physical continuity and structural precision

method_moves.move: contrast_alternative: 对比高阶 unrolled gradients、implicit differentiation 和频率错配的 alternating updates。

evidence.anchor: requires high-order unrolled gradients or implicit differentiation

method_moves.move: derive: 以 `β` 缩放 validation 梯度，将其并入 detector 的 first-order inner update。

evidence.anchor: β controls how strongly the outer-level objective influences

method_moves.move: derive: 用最新 `ω^(t+1)` 上的 validation gradient 做 `α` 一步更新。

evidence.anchor: the hyperparameters α are updated in a one-step gradient manner

method_moves.move: define_component/derive: 以 differentiable surrogate `M` 对齐 offline pseudo-label 与当前 response，更新 `θ` 并抑制噪声监督过拟合。

evidence.anchor: the first term encourages M to reproduce the physics-induced pseudo-labels

method_moves.move: connect_to_experiment: 把 `α` 的样本贡献、`θ` 的标签质量与 detector response 联系到 validation feedback。

evidence.anchor: outer objective provides a stable signal for generalization-oriented weighting

method_moves.move: summarize: 将动态聚合概括为兼顾训练稳定和超参数校准的 unified optimization。

evidence.anchor: preventing the validation loss from collapsing into self-consistency

experimental_design.name: 数据划分
experimental_design.description: 前三个独立数据集按官方协议 6:2:2；SIRST3 合并三个 subset 后同样 6:2:2 train/val/test。

experimental_design.name: 模型与基线
experimental_design.description: 七种 detector 为 MLCLNet、ALCLNet、DNANet、ISNet、UIUNet、GGLNet、MSDANet；策略基线为 LESPS、PAL、MCLC，Full 为 fully supervised upper bound；伪掩膜另比较 COM、SAM、SAM2。

experimental_design.name: 训练预算与优化器

experimental_design.name: 分支更新与预处理

final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 保留 Eq. (1)–(4)、Figure 2、数据/训练设置、Tables 1–3、Figures 5–7、Tables 4–5 和 Figure 8，足以解释方法与主要决策。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 本版本无 appendix；Dθ 参数化、K/τ/ρ/β、superpixel 实现、硬件软件、seed 聚合、训练成本和失败全集均未提供。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Table 3 将伪标签组件 A1–A4 与优化组件 B1–B4 分组，Tables 4–5 同时报告 mask quality 与 per-target time，形成较清晰的机制和成本诊断。
final_judgment.largest_gap: significantly/consistently 等强措辞缺少检验和跨 seed 汇总；30% 结论依赖曲线；validation pseudo-label 偏差、physics field 真实性与部署代价未独立验证。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 监督生成与样本贡献同时改变时，应分组消融监督和优化路径，并在同一评测对象上同时报告质量、效果和成本证据。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适合有可分离监督生成/训练权重路径的视觉学习方法；模块高度耦合或缺少成本指标时，需用机制对照和失败分层补足，不能仅凭单一消融表宣称闭环。

evidence_coverage.method: Claims were counted after page-by-page PDF/render/text reconciliation; each substantive structured judgment has at least one physical-page evidence object.

count_summary.main_text_physical_pages: 1–9, with References beginning in the right column of p.9

statistical_profile.aggregation_units: image/target-level ISTD metrics aggregated per dataset and detector; the paper does not give metric formulas or denominator details.

statistical_profile.uncertainty: No standard deviation, error bars, intervals, hypothesis tests, multiple-comparison correction, bootstrap or Bayesian analysis reported.
